title: ClearQuick
description: Intelligent item and XP orb cleaner with chunk-based processing for maximum server stability.
body:
# 🧹 ClearQuick ### **Lightweight & Intelligent Item Management.** ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.0-blue?style=for-the-badge) ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.12.2--26.1+-gold?style=for-the-badge) ![Folia](https://img.shields.io/badge/Performance-Optimized-brightgreen?style=for-the-badge) ---
## ✨ **What is ClearQuick?** **ClearQuick** is a modern, high-performance solution for managing ground entities. Unlike other heavy lag-clear plugins, ClearQuick is designed to be **unobtrusive and smart**, ensuring your server stays clean without impacting the player experience or TPS. --- ## 🚀 **Key Features** * ⏱️ **Smart Intervals:** Set automatic cleanup cycles with fully customizable countdowns. * 🚨 **Emergency Auto-Cleanup:** Real-time detection that triggers an instant cleanup if ground entities exceed a safe threshold. * 💎 **Intelligent Whitelist:** Protect specific items (Diamonds, Iron, etc.) from being accidentally removed. * 🌍 **World Isolation:** Disable cleanup in specific worlds (Nether, End) to preserve gameplay mechanics. * ⚡ **TPS Protection:** Uses a **chunk-per-tick processing engine** to distribute the workload across multiple ticks, preventing lag spikes. * 🧪 **XP Orb Management:** Separate toggles for items and XP orbs. --- ## 🧩 **Commands & Permissions** | Command | Alias | Function | Permission | |:---|:---|:---|:---| | `/cq clear` | `/lagg` | Manual instant cleanup | `clearquick.admin` | | `/cq interval ` | | Dynamically change cleanup timing | `clearquick.admin` | | `/cq status` | | View current entity counts and next cleanup | `clearquick.admin` | | `/cq toggle` | | Enable/Disable automatic tasks | `clearquick.admin` | | `/cq reload` | | Reload configuration | `clearquick.admin` | --- ## ⚙️ **Performance Tuning** ClearQuick includes a unique `chunks-per-tick` setting. This allows large servers to process the world in small chunks, ensuring that even with thousands of entities, the **Main Thread** remains perfectly smooth. ---
**The smart choice for lag-free survival and competitive servers.** **Built for efficiency. Built for Spigot & Paper.**
